description: Shows the exact review-request text, sender number and recipients for customers with a completed service, with a fingerprint for approval. Requires the client owner, the sms:write scope, and an SMS review installation where Kai is confirmed as the review tool. It sends nothing and saves nothing.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fromNumber.description: The business number to send from (E.164).

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

milestones.description: One completed-service record per customer: leadId, completedAt and an evidence reference.

minimumDays.description: Minimum days (7-365) since a customer was last asked before they can be asked again.
